turns.text: Hello. Staff already closed my damage claim and told me the pale patches belong in the drawing. I reject that decision.
I'm sorry for the trouble. I've passed your objection to a colleague, who will take over and review the damage claim with you. Please keep your order number and the email used for the order ready.

Customer has not yet given an order number or email, so they are not verified and no order was checked. Please review the closed damage claim with the customer.
